Committee: Boards, Agencies and Commissions
Sponsor: Drummond
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 02/22/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 274 as introduced would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Board of Cosmetology by an undetermined amount, to license and regulate mobile salons which could be offset, wholly or in part, by any required license fees established by rule of the Board.
Howard Sanderford, Chair
Boards, Agencies and Commissions

Committee: Governmental Affairs
Sponsor: Drummond
Analyst: Bryan Young
Date: 03/04/2021
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 274 as passed the House of Representatives would increase the administrative obligations of the Alabama Board of Cosmetology by an undetermined amount, to license and regulate mobile salons which could be offset, wholly or in part, by any required license fees established by rule of the Board.
Jimmy Holley, Chairperson
Governmental Affairs
